layers.process: Saanane Island National Park: Private boats must follow park instructions and use designated landing points. The guide describes a short boat transfer to the island. Confirm current arrangements directly with the park.
Saanane Island National Park: The park guide says fishing is permit-only and catch-and-release under ranger guidance. Ask the park about current permitted activities and conditions.
